description: This file contains an abstract base class for unit testing implementations of the AbstractCommandStrategy within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides utility methods for testing command application results, error handling, and expected event generation related to Thing commands.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategyTest
classes.description: Abstract base class providing utility methods and setup for unit tests of command strategy implementations in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants and mocks for use in unit tests.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Provides a default command strategy context for testing.

methods.name: assertModificationResult
methods.description: Verifies the successful application of a command strategy resulting in a mutated Thing event.

methods.name: assertErrorResult
methods.description: Verifies that applying a command strategy results in the expected error/exception.

methods.name: assertQueryResult
methods.description: Verifies that a command strategy produces the expected query result.

methods.name: assertUnhandledResult
methods.description: Verifies that an unhandled command results in the expected error.

methods.name: applyStrategy
methods.description: Helper to apply a command strategy and get the result.
